newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid cautious trading.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to be mixed on Monday amid cautious trading as parliament is due to pass the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), brokers said.

"The investors are likely to remain cautious in making fresh commitments ahead of the approval of the budget," said broker Kurshid Alam. The DSE all-share price index gained 5.31 points or 0.47 percent to 1,128.49 at the close of trading on Sunday. Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
